source_tables: Table 1 N-terminal sequence and length; Table 2 DPP4 half-life mean, SD and replicate count
assay: Purified recombinant human DPP4, 0.1 micromolar, 37 C; MALDI-TOF parent-peptide time course
endpoint: Full-length parent peptide half-life in minutes; not an in-vivo half-life
inclusion: Reported numerical DPP4 half-life, length 27-42 residues, and complete Gudipati 2024 human DPP4 qPISA P2-P1-P1-prime coefficients
exclusions: BNP and substance P lack the published qPISA P1-prime Lys coefficient. Chemokines and censored non-cleavages are outside this short-peptide calibration.
